card.title: Xbox One Controller does not turn on repair

source.title: Xbox One Controller does not turn on repair

claims.statement: Xbox One controller dead: check battery contacts for corrosion, try new batteries and USB; then measure voltages on the board-to-board connector and around the PCB.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
